feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 18 May 2026 8:02am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 18 May 2026 at 8:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

There is a Strong Wind warning in operation for tonight.


##Synopsis##

A shallow low lies near northern Scotland, with a slow-moving low in the mid-Atlantic, pushing associated frontal troughs across the Irish Sea this evening & tonight.


##Wind##

Mainly west or southwest force 2 or 3, backing south or southwest 3 or 4 this morning. Then backing and increasing south or southeast 4 or 5 this afternoon and 5 or 6 occasionally 7 later this evening & overnight.


##State of Sea##

Slight, building mainly moderate tonight.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, but with occasional showers in the east of the area at first this morning. Then rain spreading from the southwest this evening, becoming heavy at times overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in the showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast force 5 or 6, veering south Tuesday morning, and south or southwest during the afternoon. Then decreasing 4 or 5 overnight into Wednesday.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, but occasionally rough in the south of the area for a time Tuesday afternoon & evening.


##Weather##

Rain clearing to occasional showers Tuesday morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain at first or showers.
